mapper.select: select cg.group_id as "groupId", cg.group_name as "groupName", cg.description as "description", cg.managing_department as "managingDepartment", cg.system_use_yn as "systemUseYn", cg.status as "status", count(dc.code_value) as "detailCodeCount", cg.created_at as "createdAt", cg.updated_at as "updatedAt" from code_groups cg left join detail_codes dc on dc.group_id = cg.group_id and dc.status != 'DELETED' where cg.group_id = #{groupId} and cg.status != 'DELETED' group by cg.group_id, cg.group_name, cg.description, cg.managing_department, cg.system_use_yn, cg.status, cg.created_at, cg.updated_at

select dc.group_id as "groupId", dc.code_value as "codeValue", dc.code_name as "codeName", dc.system_use_yn as "systemUseYn", dc.valid_start_date as "validStartDate", dc.valid_end_date as "validEndDate", dc.status as "status", dc.change_reason as "changeReason", dc.updated_by as "updatedBy", dc.updated_at as "updatedAt", case when dc.system_use_yn = 'Y' and dc.status = 'ACTIVE' and (dc.valid_start_date is null or dc.valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE) and (dc.valid_end_date is null or dc.valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) then true else false end as "selectableForNewInput" from detail_codes dc where dc.group_id = #{groupId} and dc.status != 'DELETED' order by dc.sort_order, dc.code_value limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(1) from detail_codes dc where dc.group_id = #{groupId} and dc.status != 'DELETED'

select dc.group_id as "groupId", dc.code_value as "codeValue", dc.code_name as "codeName", dc.system_use_yn as "systemUseYn", dc.valid_start_date as "validStartDate", dc.valid_end_date as "validEndDate", dc.status as "status", dc.change_reason as "changeReason", dc.updated_by as "updatedBy", dc.updated_at as "updatedAt", true as "selectableForNewInput" from detail_codes dc where dc.group_id = #{groupId} and dc.system_use_yn = 'Y' and dc.status = 'ACTIVE' and (dc.valid_start_date is null or dc.valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE) and (dc.valid_end_date is null or dc.valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) order by dc.sort_order, dc.code_value

select dc.group_id as "groupId", dc.code_value as "codeValue", dc.code_name as "codeName", dc.system_use_yn as "systemUseYn", dc.valid_start_date as "validStartDate", dc.valid_end_date as "validEndDate", dc.status as "status", dc.change_reason as "changeReason", dc.updated_by as "updatedBy", dc.updated_at as "updatedAt", case when dc.system_use_yn = 'Y' and dc.status = 'ACTIVE' and (dc.valid_start_date is null or dc.valid_start_date <= CURRENT_DATE) and (dc.valid_end_date is null or dc.valid_end_date >= CURRENT_DATE) then true else false end as "selectableForNewInput" from detail_codes dc where dc.group_id = #{groupId} and dc.code_value = #{codeValue} and dc.status != 'DELETED'
mapper.update: update detail_codes set system_use_yn = #{systemUseYn}, valid_start_date = #{validStartDate}, valid_end_date = #{validEndDate}, status = case when #{systemUseYn} = 'Y' then 'ACTIVE' else 'INACTIVE' end, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, updated_by = #{updatedBy}, change_reason = #{changeReason} where group_id = #{groupId} and code_value = #{codeValue} and status != 'DELETED'
